meta.name: team-communication-protocols
meta.description: Structured messaging protocols for agent team communication including message type selection, plan approval, shutdown procedures, and anti-patterns to avoid. Use this skill when establishing communication norms for a newly spawned team, when deciding whether to send a direct message or a broadcast, when a team-lead needs to review and approve an implementer's plan before work begins, when orchestrating a graceful team shutdown after all tasks are complete, or when debugging why teammates are not coordinating correctly at integration points.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 规范智能体团队的沟通与协作流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在开发多智能体系统,需要统一团队通信规则
copy.fit_line_en: For you if building multi-agent systems and need clear messaging protocols.

howto.what: Claude 会按协议管理团队消息:默认给单个队友发直接消息,只在影响全局时才广播;处理计划审批和团队关闭流程;沟通时使用队友名字并避免常见反模式。
howto.when: 当新团队需要定沟通规则、决定用直接消息还是广播、或处理计划审批等流程时触发。

say.text: 给 implementer-1 发直接消息,说接口已就绪
say.note: 会以 message 类型发送,不走广播

say.text: 审查 implementer-1 的计划,批准或给出修改意见
say.note: 触发计划审批,批准或驳回带反馈

say.text: 所有任务完成,逐个向队友发送关闭请求
say.note: 触发优雅关闭流程,等待各队友确认

howto.what_en: Claude will manage team messages by protocol: direct messages to individual teammates by default, broadcasts only for global impact; handle plan approval and team shutdown flows; use teammate names and avoid common anti-patterns.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a new team needs communication rules, when choosing between direct message and broadcast, or when handling plan approval processes.

say_en.text: Send a direct message to implementer-1 that the API is ready.
say_en.note: Sent as type 'message', not a broadcast.

say_en.text: Review implementer-1's plan, approve it or give feedback.
say_en.note: Triggers plan approval: approve true, or reject with feedback.

say_en.text: All tasks are done; send shutdown requests to each teammate.
say_en.note: Triggers graceful shutdown, waits for teammate confirmations.
